llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The change from map[string]string to a named type would break any code that directly assigns map literals or accesses labels without using accessor methods. Multiple Kubernetes ecosystem projects would be affected, particularly in their test files and controller logic where metadata labels are commonly manipulated.

FILES:
- argo-cd/test/e2e/fixture/app/contexts.go — Direct map assignment to metadata labels in test fixtures
- argo-cd/pkg/apis/application/v1alpha1/types.go — Type definitions using ObjectMeta with label operations
- cert-manager/pkg/apis/meta/v1/types.go — API type definitions embedding ObjectMeta
- external-secrets/apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/externalsecret_types.go — Custom resource definitions with label fields
- prometheus-operator/pkg/apis/monitoring/v1/prometheus_types.go — Prometheus CRD with metadata label handling
- loki/production/operator/api/v1/loki_types.go — Loki operator CRD definitions
- opentelemetry-operator/apis/opentelemetry/v1alpha1/opentelemetrycollector_types.go — OpenTelemetry CRD with ObjectMeta
